```bash
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(".env")
keys_of_interest = [
    "AI_MOCK_MODE", "IMAGE_GEN_PROVIDER", "IMAGE_GEN_BASE_URL", "IMAGE_GEN_API_KEY",
    "IMAGE_GEN_MODEL", "IMAGE_CAPTION_MODEL", "MINIMAX_API_KEY", "MINIMAX_BASE_URL",
    "MINIMAX_IMAGE_MODEL", "MINIMAX_TEXT_MODEL", "TEXT_GEN_PROVIDER", "TEXT_GEN_BASE_URL",
    "TEXT_GEN_API_KEY", "TEXT_GEN_MODEL", "VIDEO_GEN_PROVIDER", "VIDEO_GEN_API_KEY",
    "VIDEO_GEN_MODEL", "INSPIREX_AI_CONFIG"
]
seen = set()
for raw in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
    s = raw.strip()
    if not s or s.startswith("#"):
        # still record commented keys
        line = s.lstrip("#").strip()
        if "=" in line:
            k = line.split("=",1)[0].strip()
            if k in keys_of_interest and k not in seen:
                print(f"COMMENTED {k}")
                seen.add(k)
        continue
    if "=" not in s:
        continue
    k, v = s.split("=", 1)
    k = k.strip()
    v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    seen.add(k)
    if k not in keys_of_interest and not any(x in k for x in ("MINIMAX","TEXT_GEN","IMAGE_GEN","VIDEO_GEN","AI_MOCK")):
        continue
    if "KEY" in k or "TOKEN" in k:
        if v:
            print(f"{k}=SET len={len(v)} prefix={v[:8]}...")
        else:
            print(f"{k}=EMPTY")
    else:
        print(f"{k}={v if v else 'EMPTY'}")
for k in keys_of_interest:
    if k not in seen:
        print(f"MISSING {k}")
PY
else
  echo "no .env"
fi

for p in "$HOME/InspireX/ai-services.json" "$HOME/InspireX/Library/ai-services.json"; do

print("keys=", list(data.keys()))
PY
  else

echo
```

```bash
import json, os, re, urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("/Users/qiubin/Documents/GitHub/inspireX")
guide = Path("/Users/qiubin/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/expe/Github/6-资源与技术/5-API资源/Minimax接入指南.md")
env_path = root / ".env"
log_dir = root / ".run"
log_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
log_path = log_dir / "ai-config.log"

def log(msg: str) -> None:
    line = f"[{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}] {msg}"
    print(line)
    with log_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")

text = guide.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
m = re.search(r"MINIMAX_CODING_API_KEY\s*=\s*(\S+)", text)
if not m:
    raise SystemExit("guide_missing_MINIMAX_CODING_API_KEY")
key = m.group(1).strip()
if not key or key.startswith("#"):
    raise SystemExit("guide_key_empty")

env = env_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
env2, n = re.subn(r"^MINIMAX_API_KEY=.*$", f"MINIMAX_API_KEY={key}", env, count=1, flags=re.M)
if n == 0:
    env2 = env.rstrip() + f"\nMINIMAX_API_KEY={key}\n"
env_path.write_text(env2, encoding="utf-8")
log(f"env_updated MINIMAX_API_KEY=SET len={len(key)} prefix={key[:6]}...")

base = "https://api.minimaxi.com"
payload = {
    "cmd": "set_ai_settings",
    "args": {
        "text": {
            "provider": "minimax",
            "baseUrl": base,
            "model": "MiniMax-M3",
            "apiKey": key,
        },
        "image": {
            "provider": "minimax",
            "baseUrl": base,
            "model": "image-01",
            "apiKey": key,
        },
    },
}

def redact(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        out = {}
        for k, v in obj.items():
            lk = str(k).lower()
            if "key" in lk and isinstance(v, str) and v:
                out[k] = f"SET len={len(v)}"
            else:
                out[k] = redact(v)
        return out
    if isinstance(obj, list):
        return [redact(x) for x in obj]
    return obj

rpc_ok = False
try:
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        "http://127.0.0.1:18765/v1/invoke",
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Authorization": "Bearer [REDACTED:curl-auth-header]",
        },
        method="POST",
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=8) as resp:
        body = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    rpc_ok = True
    log("rpc_set_ai_settings " + json.dumps(redact(body), ensure_ascii=False))
except Exception as e:
    log(f"rpc_set_ai_settings_fail err={type(e).__name__}: {e}")

# persist fallback json (no secrets in repo)
cfg = Path.home() / "InspireX" / "ai-services.json"
if not rpc_ok:
    cfg.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stored = {
        "text": {"provider": "minimax", "baseUrl": base, "apiKey": key, "model": "MiniMax-M3"},
        "image": {"provider": "minimax", "baseUrl": base, "apiKey": key, "model": "image-01"},
        "video": {"provider": "mock", "baseUrl": "", "apiKey": "", "model": ""},
    }
    cfg.write_text(json.dumps(stored, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    log(f"wrote_fallback_config path={cfg}")

# verify env (no key dump)
env_now = env_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
has = bool(re.search(r"^MINIMAX_API_KEY=\S+", env_now, re.M))
log(f"env_key_nonempty={has} text_model=MiniMax-M3 image_model=image-01")
```

```bash
python3 << 'PY'
import json, re, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

env = Path("/Users/qiubin/Documents/GitHub/inspireX/.env").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
key = re.search(r"^MINIMAX_API_KEY=(\S+)", env, re.M).group(1)
body = json.dumps({
    "model": "MiniMax-M3",
    "max_tokens": 16,
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "只回复ok"}],
}).encode("utf-8")
req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://api.minimaxi.com/v1/chat/completions",
    data=body,
    headers={
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
    },
    method="POST",
)
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    model = data.get("model")
    choices = data.get("choices") or []
    text = ""
    if choices:
        text = ((choices[0].get("message") or {}).get("content") or "")[:40]
    print(f"text_ping_ok model={model} reply={text!r}")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    raw = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:400]
    print(f"text_ping_fail http={e.code} body={raw}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"text_ping_fail err={type(e).__name__}: {e}")
PY
```
